item.title: Major drug lord 'El Mencho' killed in Mexican military operation with US intelligence support
item.description: Mexican military announces death of "El Mencho," the $15 million bounty CJNG cartel leader, in Jalisco operation amid violence and U.S. cooperation.

item.title: Who is El Mencho? Inside the rise of CJNG’s fallen kingpin and the cartel he built
item.description: Authorities said Mexican forces killed Ruben "El Mencho" Oseguera, the notorious Jalisco cartel leader who became Mexico's most wanted drug kingpin.

item.title: 'Get the hell out': GOP lawmakers blast suggestion that Olympic patriotism causes 'shame'
item.description: HuffPost was called out on X on Sunday over a piece about feeling discomfort rooting for the USA in the Olympics, as critics responded with USA chants.

item.title: Iran unrest escalates as gunfire, tear gas hit universities amid looming US strike
item.description: Tehran and Mashhad universities saw anti-government protests Sunday, with students chanting against Ali Khamenei as security forces reportedly used tear gas.

item.title: Prince William reveals toll of Andrew arrest in first public appearance since royal scandal
item.description: Prince William admitted he's not in a "calm state" while walking BAFTAs red carpet with Kate Middleton three days after former Prince Andrew arrest over Epstein ties.

item.title: Pete Hegseth dubs Team USA goaltender the 'Secretary of Defense' after amazing Olympic save
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth praised Team USA goalie Connor Hellebuyck as the 'Secretary of Defense' after his stellar 41-save performance led to Olympic hockey gold in Milan.

item.title: Cartels outgun police: Rocket launchers seized in El Mencho raid spotlight CJNG firepower
item.description: Mexican forces killed cartel boss "El Mencho" and seized rocket launchers capable of downing aircraft, revealing CJNG's extensive military arsenal.

item.title: Newsom says 'fate' will decide if he faces off against Harris in 2028 presidential primary
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom, D-Calif., avoided answering whether he plans to face off against former Vice President Kamala Harris in a 2028 presidential primary.

item.title: US assets in Middle East positioned for ‘highly kinetic’ war, ex-Pentagon official warns
item.description: U.S. launches major Middle East military buildup with overwhelming force capabilities against Iran as nuclear talks continue, former Pentagon official Dana Stroul said.

item.title: Soccer matches postponed after Mexico kills cartel leader ‘El Mencho’ near World Cup host
item.description: Mexican soccer matches were postponed after the army reportedly killed drug lord "El Mencho" near the World Cup host city Guadalajara, triggering violence in the region.
